title: Instant Crash without Play Services
symptom: The app flashes up for a short moment (0.5 sec) and then instantly crashes when opened on a device without Google Play services or Micro G. The crash log shows a ClassNotFoundException for com.google.android.gms.measurement.AppMeasurementService.
cause: The cause is suspected to be a bug in the updated google play libraries, which was introduced in the 2022.09.08b release.
fix: The Dec 24th nightly resolves the issue.
evidence_quote: Please try the Dec 24th nightly (available now) and see if this resolves the issue.
